messages:
dinesh: Starting the migration window now. Plan is a consistent snapshot -> small schema change (add computed_col) -> staggered backfill in 10% tenant waves with a controlled rate limiter. No big table locks expected but we'll verify. If anything goes sideways we'll unwind to the snapshot and stop writes to affected partitions.

deploybot: deploy queued: migration_job_id=mg-2026-03-21-01. Running preflight checks... config: waves=10, wave_delay=5m, max_rows_per_second=200.

marie: Quick Q: are read replicas going to serve stale indexes during the backfill? want to confirm trace continuity for search traffic.

alex: replicas will continue to serve reads. We'll publish a short delay window in the console if we hit replica lag > 30s.

sara: Added an explicit feature-flag gate for the new computed_col. Backfill will run independently of the flag; app will only read it when ff=true. Escape hatch: flip ff->false and pause waves if needed.

alex: SQL snippet for backfill job (smallest batch):
```sql
UPDATE items
SET computed_col = compute_fn(payload)
WHERE id BETWEEN $start AND $end
LIMIT 1000;
```

dinesh: Rollback/abort criteria (sticky):
- errors: any single wave with >1% UPDATE failures for 5 consecutive minutes -> abort.
- latency: write p99 increase >100ms over baseline for 5m -> abort.
- replica lag: sustained >60s across >20% replicas -> pause waves and investigate.
If triggered: 1) stop scheduling new waves 2) notify on-call 3) run unwind to snapshot: restore read-only from snapshot for affected tenant ranges 4) coordinate manual cutover to prior schema version.

ops-bot: Alert channels configured: #incidents (pager oncall), #eng-releases (pings), and a runbook pinned: https://intranet/runbooks/migration-snapshot-unwind. Playbook added: unwind_steps.md.

marie: For the unwind: how long does restore-from-snapshot take per shard? estimate?

alex: Typical restore is ~8-12m per shard for full snapshot; we have incremental checkpoints so targeted ranges usually 2-4m. We should still budget 30m for full rollback ops including validation.

sara: Dev note: I added a preflight dry-run on a small sample tenant to ensure compute_fn is deterministic and idempotent. results look good.

dinesh: OK, running wave 1 now (tenants 1-10). Will post quick health ticks every 5m. If you see anything odd ping @sara and @alex.

deploybot: wave 1 started: mg-2026-03-21-01-wave-1 job_id=mgw-001.

alex: Wave 1 reports: 10 tenants, 1000 rows per tenant, 0 failures so far. p50 write latency change +12ms.

marie: :thumbsup: good. keep an eye on replica lag.

dinesh: Wave 2 queued, delay 5m.

ops-bot: Health tick (5m): errors=0, avg_rows/s=85, p99_write_delta=18ms, replica_lag_max=12s. All within thresholds.

sara: continuing waves. reminder: feature-flag remains OFF for reads until we validate end-to-end.

alex: Wave 4 flagged 2 small constraint conflicts that were auto-retriable. deploybot retried and succeeded. Logging in migration logs.

dinesh: Noted. If retries exceed 3 for any tenant, we'll cut that tenant out of the current run and escalate.

marie: Thanks — can we add a small dashboard widget for this specific migration (progress + failures) in the release console?

dinesh: Yup, doing that now.

deploybot: wave 10 (final wave) completed. total_rows=1,234,567, total_failures=7 (all retried & succeeded).

ops-bot: Post-migration checklist started: run validation queries, check search index freshness, remove temporary rate limits after 1h.

alex: Validation run: sample queries matched expected results for 99.97% of checked rows. We'll run a deeper check overnight.

sara: If any regression shows up in the next 24h we keep the ff off and open an incident.

dinesh: Closing notes: no rollback required. Saved final snapshot id=snap-4102345678-post. Marking migration as successful in release log and adding notes to release notes: "computed_col added; staggered backfill completed with minimal disruption; rollback plan prepared but not used." Thanks team. :party-popper:
